abu-dhabi._grade_moved: C to B on 2026-08-18 and B to A the same day, neither by a schema migration. The VAT ambiguity that set the C ceiling fell to two archived booklets showing an unchanged rate across the introduction of the tax; the recurring-charge component that held it at B was closed by the publisher's own Understand Your Bill guide, where the water service line equals the consumption total including VAT with no residual. This guard exists to catch a migration moving a figure. A figure that appears because the evidence arrived is the system working — as Singapore's C to B was — and the snapshot is updated with the reason rather than the guard weakened. The city was unpriced here before; the price is new, not moved.

tokyo._added: Added on 2026-08-18, when Tokyo first cleared the gate. price_m3 is the structural price, which is the comparable one and the one that goes on the map; the payable price of 55 yen/m3 travels beside it in the relief block and is the headline on the city page. Both are locked here so that a change to either is a decision somebody makes rather than a build somebody ships.
